primary_title: IL-17 markedly up-regulates beta-defensin-2 expression in human airway epithelium via JAK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-17A-induced airway beta-defensin-2 as an epithelial antimicrobial output; the cited primary shows IL-17-dependent DEFB4/hBD-2 message and protein induction, IL17R blockade, and promoter-reporter activation in primary human airway epithelium.
limitations_preserved: Human airway epithelial context; DEFB4 transcript is distinct from mature secreted hBD-2 peptide and antimicrobial activity; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
